# 281_R6FIX.18 — BL-118: `no-raw-set-tenant` catches `set_config('app.tenant_id')`; substrate rides withTenant (run ledger)

- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/281_R6FIX.18__set-tenant-lint.md` (run-time insert — BL-118 from the
  277_R6LOW.1 sweep, RH-A1-9, REQ-DATA-4/REQ-ARCH-25) · **Branch:**
  `stevevitali/r6fix-18-set-tenant-lint` · **Base:** `main` (`3a840396`) · **Date:** 2026-11-16 ·
  **Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high
- **Scope:** lint-rule extension + call-site migration. **$0**, no prod/live contact; no live
  journey legs run (the migrated blocks are seed/read paths exercised by their own legs later).

## Defect (read, not inferred)

`no-raw-set-tenant` scanned literals/templates for `set [local] app.tenant_id` only. The
parameterized form `set_config('app.tenant_id', …, true)` — which the sanctioned wrapper itself
uses — was invisible to the rule anywhere it appeared, so hand-rolled copies of the wrapper's
GUC set bypassed the withTenant-only invariant silently. Census at this base (14 sites):

- `packages/journeys`: fixture-substrate.ts:109, stb5a.ts ×5 (:1240/:1360/:1779/:1826/:1902),
  stb5b.ts:62, steps.ts:2675 — all `begin → set_config → work → commit/rollback` hand-rolls.
- `integration/src/server-postgres.test.ts:71-72` — the tenant-isolation probe hand-rolled
  `set role` + `set_config` (exactly the seam `withTenant …, { role: USER_SERVING_ROLE }` owns).
- `packages/live-clients/stb5a-scoped-query.mjs`, `stb5a-import-repro.mjs` — deliberate
  ROLLBACK probes.
- `packages/db/src/rls.ts` — the sanctioned wrapper (the allowlist).

## Fix

- **Rule** (`tools/eslint-plugin-rhema/rules/no-raw-set-tenant.js`): new arm flags
  `set_config('app.tenant_id'`/`"app.tenant_id"` in any string literal or template chunk unless
  `context.filename` ends `packages/db/src/rls.ts` — the single allowlisted file. New message id
  `setConfigTenant`; the raw-SET arm is unchanged and still applies everywhere.
- **Migrations to `withTenant`** — every hand-rolled block in journeys (8 sites incl. the
  blind-read's preserved null-on-failure arm and the read-only `scopedQuery`) and the
  integration probe (`withTenant(client, "ws_cia", fn, { role: USER_SERVING_ROLE })`).
- **Allowlist-with-justification** — the two `.mjs` probes keep the hand-roll with
  `eslint-disable-next-line -- <reason>`: both deliberately ROLL BACK; `withTenant` commits on
  success, which for argv-shaped SQL / an import repro would write to prod. This is the
  documented "explicit allowlist with justification" disposition the BL row offered.
- **Cleanup** — `packages/journeys/src/session.test.ts`: dropped a duplicate `count` key my
  earlier union-merge overlay left in the sign-in mock (identical value; #356's original + my
  278_R6FIX.15 append).

## Evidence

- `pnpm exec vitest run tools/eslint-plugin-rhema/rules/no-raw-set-tenant.test.ts` — 2/2 green:
  rls.ts-filename `set_config` valid, other-file literal/template/double-quoted invalid, raw
  `SET` arm still flagged everywhere.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/journeys/src tools/eslint-plugin-rhema` — **288/288 green**
  (37 files).
- `pnpm turbo lint` — **46/46 packages green** under the extended rule — zero remaining
  `set_config('app.tenant_id')` sites outside the wrapper on the entire linted tree (the rule
  file + its own test fixtures are inside `tools/`, outside every package's lint scope — same
  posture as before; their message strings necessarily name the patterns).
- `pnpm --filter @rhema/journeys typecheck` — clean; eslint clean on every touched file.

## Constraints kept

Never merged (OPERATOR); no prod/live; $0. Allowlist is exactly one file; disables carry
explicit reasons; no tenant-bypass path added; no live journey leg run or claimed.
